name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-07-28, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
